queries:
SELECT e.status, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(c) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a2.link_to_member) AS c FROM attendance a2 INNER JOIN event e2 ON a2.link_to_event = e2.event_id GROUP BY e2.status)) AS proportion
FROM attendance a
INNER JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
GROUP BY e.status

SELECT e.status, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS REAL) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) FROM attendance) AS percentage
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
GROUP BY e.status
